summary: Official local evidence establishes Gaoping's Natural Resources Bureau and real-estate registration center as custodians and exposes a public service platform with a cadastral-map inquiry entry. Anonymous inspection did not verify a public parcel ID plus geometry service, so no GeoJSON sample is retained and runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Chinese discovery queries, outcomes, and actual URLs are recorded in city-9228-gaoping.json.

requestOutcomes.outcome: HTTP page retrieved; official local platform identified; no parcel data in landing page.
HTTP page retrieved; JavaScript revealed the public inquiry navigation and cadastral/attachment inquiry route /online/public/search/fcfht.
Redirected to the ordinary login page; no credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, or private token was used. No parcel request was issued beyond the public route inspection.
HTTP page retrieved; viewer loads pano2vr_player.js, skin.js, and pano.xml. It is a panorama viewer, not a cadastral parcel feature service.
HTTP XML retrieved; panorama nodes and tile URLs are present, but no parcel IDs, parcel schema, CRS, or vector geometries are present.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [35.78945448775, 112.930606499431] was preserved and was not shifted.

No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, personal, or unsafe registration fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is research bookkeeping only and does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter; serial reviewer qualification remains required.
